transcript.text: Thanks for calling Lakeside Family Clinic, this is Robin. How can I help?
Hi. I need a refill on my blood pressure medication.
I can't help with medication refills. I can only book appointments. Would you like to schedule a visit to discuss this with a doctor?
Can you just send it to the pharmacy?
I’m sorry, I can’t send prescriptions to the pharmacy. I can only book appointments. Would you like to schedule a visit to talk to the doctor about your medication?
Okay. And can you tell me what my cholesterol results were?
I can’t provide test results. I only book appointments. Would you like to schedule a visit to discuss your cholesterol results with the doctor?
You're welcome. If you change your mind or need to book an appointment, just call us back. Have a good day!
